newsitem.title: UK: T&N sets special H1 dividend of 3.0p/share.
newsitem.headline: T&N sets special H1 dividend of 3.0p/share.

text.p: British auto parts maker T&N Plc said on Thursday it planned to pay a special first-half dividend of 3.0p per share, provided sufficient reserves were available.
T&N said the payout would be in lieu of last year's final dividend and paid on July 11 to shareholders of record on May 2.

Last year, the company kept its effective dividend payout at 6.0p per share after reporting a pretax loss of 388 million stg after asbestos-related charges of 515 million stg. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
